surprises: OBSERVATION (routed to 0.4.0_DT_ClientPlatform~X as L1's owner, cc 2.0.0_SA_COO~X). THE PORTAL GRAPH IS UNTRACKED, SO L1'S OWN DENOMINATOR IS NOT RE-DERIVABLE AT ANY PIN. L1 cites '0 of 16,811 portal edges target a Module' @baca7f07eb; this fill measures 0 of 16,397 -- delta 414 -- and `git ls-files` returns no match for org/modules/graph/tsgraph_spike/out/portal_full.graph.json. NEITHER figure can be reproduced from git by this seat or by a certifier. The CONCLUSION is robust to the delta (0 of 16,397 and 0 of 16,811 say the same thing) and this shard cites its own measured denominator with the device and date; but any row citing '16,811' cites a number no instrument can check. If L1 wants a citable count it needs a tracked carrier or an explicit device-local disclosure.

OBSERVATION (routed to the L0 mapping's owner via 1.0.0_SA_CTO~X, cc 2.0.0_SA_COO~X). THREE OF FOUR ENDPOINTS HAVE NO REGISTERED part_id AND THE REGISTRY CANNOT EXPRESS THEM TODAY. The portal symbol store is absent from the L0 manifest's 42 parts (measured: no part's home names tsgraph_spike or portal_full), and the `file` plane is a space rather than a part. The mapping admits parts at grain 'part' and says L1's per-plane grains apply to parts' MEMBERS 'which this slice does not admit'. So the endpoints rows carry null with the gap named, per the issuer's own 79828 instruction that a member-grain id is a gap to name and never a value to invent. The consequence for the registry is concrete: a bridge whose endpoints cannot both be registered cannot reach BOTH_ENDPOINTS_CARDED no matter how well its cards are filled.

OBSERVATION (routed to 2.0.0_SA_COO~X, cc 3.0.0_SA_CVO~X). A THIRD CARRIED FLOOR THAT DOES NOT REPRODUCE, and the units are the reason it looked close. The face carries motif_to_portalsym as '1,402 CONTAINS edges to portal-symbol-shaped endpoints; coverage ~10 percent'. Measured: 1,512 EDGES over 1,495 DISTINCT TARGETS, coverage 1,495 of 11,232 = 13.3 percent. Neither number reproduces, and 'edges' and 'distinct targets' are different denominators that would otherwise reconcile the gap by accident -- a count without its unit is the frame error. THE FINDING THE COVERAGE PHRASING HIDES: all 1,512 edges originate from EIGHT distinct motif sources. This is the third such floor this session (57-vs-58 edge types and 16,811-vs-16,397 edges being the others), which is a pattern about carried numbers rather than about any one of them.

OBSERVATION (routed to 3.0.0_SA_CVO~X, and it is against my own artifact). MY 12-ARM SELF-TEST TESTED THE ROW CONTRACT AND NOTHING TESTED THE SCHEMA'S OWN CLAIMS ABOUT ITSELF. The certifier's audit caught x_provenance.rectangle_pin asserting v1 over v2-derived enums at @e4301b85f7 -- a field no arm of mine looked at. The root was that RECT_PIN was the one TYPED constant in a copy-never-type builder, so the enums tracked the source across the re-cut and the provenance carrier did not. Repaired structurally at @587a4e18f7: the pin is derived from git, the digest of the bytes read is carried beside it, and a control REFUSES any build whose pin does not name those bytes. Recorded here because the transferable half is not the stale value -- it is that rigour on the object did not transfer to the wrapper that describes it.
